title: AuthorizationRequest v1
description: Input to the shared policy decision point. Every language calls platform.authorize with these fields.

actor.description: Identity performing the action (human, agent, service account, or automation).

workspace.description: Workspace the request is bound to; must equal the transaction's app.workspace_id.

id.description: Resource ID or URN; '*' for collection-level actions such as list and create.

workspace.description: Workspace that owns the resource, as loaded by the domain service.

enforce.description: True in the transaction that performs the action: locks delegation, membership, and approval rows to close the time-of-check gap.
